'''Cooling sleeves''' were weapon components used on [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]]<ref name="EGWT" /> and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. They were designed to dissipate the heat build-up generated by the firing of the weapon [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] such as [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] had cooling sleeves located at the base of each craft's laser cannon,<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> while repeating blasters such as a [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] had cooling sleeves located halfway along the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], behind the [[Magnetic flashback suppressor/Legends|flashback suppressor]].<ref name="EGWT" />
